name: ZSF_FCST_ITEM_ADJUSTMENT
description: This table stores all the item level adjustments and supports scenarios such as ADJUST / PULL / PULLNADJUST / DROP

columns.name: FCST_ITEM_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Primary key for the table ZSF_FCST_ITEM_ADJUSTMENT which has the item level adjustments

columns.name: FCST_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the zsf_fcst_item_detail table having the fcst items

columns.name: FCST_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the zsf_fcst_participant table having the participant information

columns.name: ADJUSTED_BY_TERRITORY_ID
columns.description: ADJUSTED_BY_TERRITORY_ID

columns.name: CUST_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party ID of the owner of the revenue item. This is a foreign key to hz_parties.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_COMMENT
columns.description: Comments given by the user performing item level adjustment

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON
columns.description: Adjustment reason selected by the user performing adjustment. This is a lookup

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTED_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource ID of the user making the last adjustment for the selected item.

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the item was last adjusted is stored in this column.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of adjustment, namely ADJUST / PULL / PULLNADJUST / DROP

columns.name: CORP_ADJUSTMENT_AMT
columns.description: Adjustment amount represented in corporate currency

columns.name: CORP_SUB_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: Sum of adjustments (delta) done by all the subordinates for this particular item . Used for calculation purpose.

columns.name: CORP_BEST_CASE_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: Best case adjustment amount amount entered by the user in corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_WORST_CASE_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: Worst case adjustment amount entered by the user in corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_BEST_CASE_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: Sum of best case adjustments(delta) done by all subordinates for a particular item. Used for calculation purpose.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_WORST_CASE_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: Sum of worst case adjustments(delta) done by all subordinates for a particular item. Used for calculation purpose.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_FILLER_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate that this is a filler and not an actual adjustment record.

columns.name: WRITE_BACK_ADJ_TO_REVN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the item adjustment has to be written back to revenue.

columns.name: FCST_ITEM_TERRITORY_ID
columns.description: Primary territory id of the item is denormalized here for query efficiency.

columns.name: ADJUST_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Adjustment period if of the item is denormalized here for query efficiency.

columns.name: CORP_EXPECT_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: This has the expected adjustment amount in corporate currency

columns.name: CORP_SUB_EXPECT_ADJ_AMT
columns.description: This has the subordinate expected adj amount in corp currency

columns.name: CORP_PRED_AMT_ADJ
columns.description: Has the adjustment for predicted amount in corporate currency

columns.name: CORP_SUB_PRED_AMT_ADJ
columns.description: Has the subordinate's predicted adjustment amount in corporate currency

columns.name: CURR_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: This has the currency exchange rate for this item adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant ID for which the adjustment is being made.

columns.name: FCST_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: FK to the snapshot of product hierarchy stored in ZSF_FCST_PRODUCT

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the channel type code. This will be used in product adjustment for metrics calculation

columns.name: FCST_ITEM_CATEGORY
columns.description: Adjusted forecast item category.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: ITADJ_QUANTITY

columns.name: WORSTCASE_ADJUSTED_FLAG

columns.name: QUANTITY_ADJUSTED_FLAG
